about: Landing from a fall V1 (docs/gameplay/fall_landing_v1_plan.md 2): falling over on a landing, 2.8 s (health/FallLanding.FALL_TICKS 56): the knees give, pitched forward onto the knees with both hands out ahead, the LEFT hand takes the ground first at 0.45 s (the body thud and the arm fracture roll; mirrored when the right hand does), all fours a moment, the right foot forward, both hands push on the knee, up.
